name: Slam Dunk
description:
You slam your orb into your foe rather than throwing it. Roll Awe vs Dexterity against an adjacent creature. On a win, the orb discharges MP and deals damage as normal, then the creature rolls Injury and checks a Condition.

Describe your dunk.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: Anything glass or ceramic that the creature is wearing, wielding or carrying is shattered.
